name: yodeck
description: Yodeck MCP connects your AI assistant to your Yodeck digital signage account so you can manage screens, media, playlists, and schedules through natural conversation. Instead of clicking through menus, you type what you need. For example, “Push the updated playlist to all screens in the London Workspace” and your AI assistant handles the rest.

interface.longDescription:
Yodeck lets a signed-in user inspect and manage digital signage in one Yodeck account: screens, media, playlists, layouts, schedules, workspaces, users, roles, groups, and folders.

The connection is https://mcp.yodeck.com/mcp. It reaches only the account that signs in. It does not read other customers' accounts.

Creating a user sends an invitation email and does not accept a password. Importing media from a URL makes Yodeck fetch that public URL. Screen updates, takeovers, and pushes change a physical display. Delete actions may be disabled on this server.
capabilities: Manage screens, media, playlists, and schedules
defaultPrompt: Show me the status of my Yodeck screens.
List my Yodeck playlists and their contents.
Help me schedule content on my Yodeck screens.

positive.description: List a bounded page of screens and summarize their status.
positive.prompt: Show up to 25 Yodeck screens, including whether each is online and registered.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a concise list of matching screens with identifiers and current online and registration status.

positive.description: Import a public image into the user's Yodeck media library.
positive.prompt: Import https://picsum.photos/200/300 into Yodeck as an image named Lobby Welcome.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the image from https://picsum.photos/200/300, following any redirect, creates media named Lobby Welcome, and reports its new identifier and processing status.

positive.description: Create a standard playlist with supplied existing content.
positive.prompt: Create a standard Yodeck playlist named Morning Loop New using media IDs 35981619 and 35981618 in that order.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a standard playlist named Morning Loop New with media 35981619 first and media 35981618 second, and returns the new playlist identifier and details.

positive.description: Assign existing content to a selected screen.
positive.prompt: Set Yodeck screen 800235 to display playlist 36800345.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates screen 800235 to display the existing playlist 36800345 and reports the resulting screen assignment.

positive.description: Push the current assignment to one physical screen.
positive.prompt: Push the currently assigned content to Yodeck screen 800235 now.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a content push for screen 800235 and reports whether the push was accepted or why it failed.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not invoked because it does not provide calendar access.

negative.description: Do not trigger for generic image analysis without Yodeck intent.
negative.prompt: Describe the colors and objects in this photograph.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not invoked because analyzing arbitrary images is outside its Yodeck workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unsupported television hardware controls.
negative.prompt: Turn down the volume on my living-room television.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not invoked because it manages Yodeck signage resources, not general consumer-device controls.

publication.release_notes: 3.5.3. updateMediaByID and orchestrateMediaBatch are open-world because they can make Yodeck fetch a public media URL.
